lines.text: A notably large wasp carcass, drowned in the web and drained of blood. Its stinger remains intact.
lines.zh: 一具硕大的黄蜂尸体，被蛛网缠住，血液已被吸干，尾刺却完好无损。
lines.raw: §7A notably large wasp carcass, drowned in the web and drained of blood. Its stinger remains intact.

lines.text: A single, all-seeing eye, forcefully removed from the Primordial Broodfather. Though expressionless, you can sense the rage that permeates throughout.
lines.zh: 从 Primordial Broodfather 身上强行剜下的一颗全视之眼。虽然毫无表情，却能感到其中弥漫的怒火。
lines.raw: §7A single, all-seeing eye, forcefully removed from the Primordial Broodfather. Though expressionless, you can sense the rage that permeates throughout.

lines.text: Sea creatures start with %s% reduced health.
lines.zh: 海洋生物的初始生命值降低 %s%。
